name: AirDropPlus-Go
purpose: Apple Shortcuts source blueprint; use docs/iPhone-shortcut.md to build or use the compatible signed shortcut.

发送: If Shortcut Input exists and is an image, Base64 encode it and POST JSON {type:image,data:<base64>} to {base_url}/api/v1/clipboard with headers Authorization={token} and ShortcutVersion=1.5.4. This avoids the iOS 1.5.4 multipart quirk where the file field body collapses to the filename.
If Shortcut Input exists and is not an image, repeat each item. Skip the iteration entirely if Get File Size of the item returns 0.
For each remaining item, POST multipart field 'file' (binary) to {base_url}/file with headers Authorization={token} and ShortcutVersion=1.5.4.
If HTTP status is not 200, show the response body via Show Notification so the user can see why the upload was rejected.
Otherwise get iPhone clipboard; if image, Base64 encode and POST JSON {type:image,data:<base64>} to {base_url}/api/v1/clipboard

Otherwise POST form field 'clipboard' to {base_url}/clipboard. Do NOT send the filename of the shared image here — the server rejects values that look like a single filename (HTTP 400 'looks like a filename') to prevent the Windows clipboard from being polluted with the photo's title.
接收: If data.type is text, copy data.data
If data.type is img, base64 decode data.data and copy result
If data.type is file, repeat IDs and GET {base_url}/file/{id}, then save/share results
测试: GET {base_url}/ with Authorization and ShortcutVersion headers

send_failure_codes.400 empty: 收到空 part（iPhone 端 file 字段没取到二进制），检查「获取 URL 内容」动作是否正确把图片/文件对象作为 file 字段传入
send_failure_codes.400 contains only its name: iPhone 端 file 字段 body 退化成文件名字符串；通常是把变量名当成了内容。改用 Get Contents of URL 时把 file 字段的「类型」设为 File，并把图片/文件变量直接拖入值
send_failure_codes.400 looks like a filename: /clipboard 表单里只放了文件名字符串，不是图片内容。把图片改走 /api/v1/clipboard 的 JSON Base64 接口，或 /file 的 multipart 二进制接口
send_failure_codes.401 invalid token: Authorization 头的 token 与 dist/data/config.json 不一致
send_failure_codes.413 request body too large: 单文件超过 max_upload_bytes（默认 1 GiB）；可在配置中调高
